# Get Found Trades

Get Found Trades helps trade and field-service businesses get visible where customers search: Google organic results, Google Maps, and AI answer engines.

**Who it is for:** Plumbers, electricians, HVAC technicians, roofers, and other field-service operators who are invisible in local search and want that fixed.

**What it does:** Builds and maintains a local-SEO-optimized web presence — structured data, Google Business Profile signals, content — wired directly to the field-service management software the business already runs.

**Integrations:** Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro.

**Status:** Early access / waitlist.

**URL:** https://getfoundtrades.com
